json.title: NASA Launches Mission to Study Asteroid Sample
json.description: NASA successfully launched a groundbreaking mission to study pristine samples from an asteroid, marking a significant milestone in planetary science. The spacecraft will travel millions of miles to collect and return samples that could reveal secrets about the early solar system.
json.creator: NASA News

json.title: James Webb Space Telescope Discovers Water Vapor on Distant Exoplanet
json.description: The James Webb Space Telescope has detected signs of water vapor in the atmosphere of an exoplanet 700 light-years away, providing crucial insights into the potential for life beyond our solar system. This discovery represents a major breakthrough in the search for habitable worlds.
json.creator: NASA News

json.title: Artemis Crew Completes Underwater Training for Moon Mission
json.description: NASA's Artemis astronauts completed a week of intensive underwater training simulating lunar surface operations. The crew practiced emergency procedures, equipment deployment, and sample collection techniques in preparation for humanity's return to the Moon.
json.creator: NASA News
